gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.flouris:
Summer blooms in splendor,
swaying like waves.
The traveler opens their arms;
scent fills their sleeves.

At witching dusk,
fireflies rise.
Insect song floods all.
The traveler, a little tired,
sinks into earthbound stars.

Shreds of sunlight fall.
The traveler lifts a hand:
a gaze flashes between fingers.
Grass swells; flowers blaze.

“How quiet…”
Amid the ceaseless rustle,
the traveler speaks.
He quickens his pace.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.abyss.w:
Where wind and water end,
dawn and dusk hang as one.
Stand here. Speak your heart.
The waves will answer.

The sea is time's expanse,
a dream, a fleeting foam.
Reflected moonlight
rushes to the traveler.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.abyss.m:
O blue as deep as starlit skies,
vast, kind, solemn, fathomless.

The stars align.
The traveler hears
a whisper kin to blood.
Fall, fall, fall…

All things spring from the sea.
Return, then, to the womb.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.far_rea:
Sunset spills gold.
The sky shines clear.
“I come from far away…”

Sun blazes on fields of gold;
all things burn bright.
Here, legends set forth.

The traveler walks among them,
through the self's wasteland.

We are wayfarers in time;
by chance, our moments cross.

Wind and rain fill the ear.
Ahead, a lightless night.
So we walk with fire;
its flicker lights a corner.

The wilds stretch on.
Alone, we cross the waste.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.deep_va:
The traveler takes the valley path,
looks up from the depths:
mist, moss, threads of silk—
an unreachable sky in each.

The murmurs have fallen still.
A tale no one knows
softly blooms in a pool.
Something undefiled
drifts slowly down the stream.

Sun above, moonshade below.
The valley floor sways—
a cradle left behind.

Come, come, a little lower.
The voices will draw near.
The names will be the same.

This shore or the other world—
do you belong here, too?
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.underwo:
Last night,
someone buried a raven.
The traveler bent low,
and lingered long.

Wind brushed its old name,
bore all softly away.
Never to return, never to return.

The underworld road descends.
White Death smiles at its end.

Below, fell fires burn on;
ash climbs the mortal world.

Who calls? Who answers?
Bloodlight floods charred earth.
Lava flows slow.

The traveler treads a burning pulse,
and storms into the gateless realm.
gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.boundle:
Ordinary days lie far behind.
The once-fallen sky
blooms slowly in the void.

Darkness twines like vines,
holds each step, guides the way.
Beyond that door, the traveler
is singular in an empty world.

Dream walks within dream;
sky hangs beyond sky.
The end, the end—
a little farther still.

The traveler records
the chaos of the void,
writes of the formless.
Wilds float amid the stars,
asleep in vast silence.

gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.ren: While wearing The Long Travail, hold Renewal and right-click to redraw the Witness requirements for all six themes.
The new requirements may be the same as before and are not guaranteed to be easier. Themes already revealed with Revelation Stones remain revealed and do not need to be revealed again.
Refreshing resets the completed journey records and Witnesses in The Long Travail. The journey must begin anew under the new requirements.
This affects all six themes; a single theme cannot be selected.
Renewal is consumed on successful use. It cannot be used without wearing The Long Travail.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.hom: While wearing The Long Travail, hold Homecoming and right-click to remove it.
The removed Long Travail is returned to the user's inventory, or dropped beside the user if there is not enough space.
Its completed journey records and Witnesses are preserved. Equipping it again allows the same journey to continue.
Removing The Long Travail also removes its effects and the additional accessory slots it provides.
Accessories that require The Long Travail, or can no longer remain equipped after those slots are removed, are returned to the inventory. Any that do not fit are dropped nearby.
Homecoming is consumed when The Long Travail is successfully removed.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.way: While wearing The Long Travail, hold a Wayguide and right-click to search for journey destinations that remain incomplete.
A Wayguide can find targets even before Revelation Stones have been used.
If any remaining target biomes can occur in the current dimension, those biomes are searched first. If there are no such biome targets, the search instead looks for incomplete structure targets.
During the search, the Wayguide hovers above the user.
If a target is found, it flies a short distance in the target's horizontal direction to show the way. It drops after a short while and can be picked up and used again.
If no target is found, the Wayguide is returned. Move elsewhere and try again.
The search range is at most 5000 blocks and only includes journey destinations in the current dimension.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.sto: Hold the stone and right-click to reveal the Witness requirements for %1$s, allowing the user to see the required destinations in The Long Travail's diary.
Exploration that meets the requirements still advances progress toward %1$s's Witness before the theme is revealed. Revealing it simply makes those targets visible.

The Long Travail does not need to be equipped to use a Revelation Stone. Revealed themes are recorded as the user's own progress and remain revealed after removing, replacing, or refreshing The Long Travail, and after death.
Each Revelation Stone reveals only its corresponding theme. The six themes must be revealed separately.
One stone is consumed when its theme is first revealed. Using a stone for an already revealed theme does not consume it.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.details.ess: While wearing The Long Travail, hold %2$s and right-click.
Depending on the current state of %1$s in The Long Travail, it helps complete the journey or begins that theme's journey anew.
Randomly completes one incomplete journey record for %1$s, without requiring a visit to the corresponding destination.
The record may be a biome or a structure and cannot be chosen.
If it is the last required record, %1$s changes from Malice to Witness.
If %1$s has already become a Witness:
Resets the completed journey records and Witness for %1$s, and redraws that theme's Witness requirements.
The journey of %1$s must then be completed again to regain its Witness.
The new requirements may be the same as before.
An essence only affects its corresponding theme. The requirements, progress, and Witnesses of other themes remain unchanged.
One essence is consumed on successful use. It is not consumed if The Long Travail is not equipped or there are no journey records available to complete.

All items except §6Perfect Fluid§r itself can be copied by default. Add item IDs to the configuration blacklist to prevent those items from being copied.

tooltip.the_long_travail.growth_items.mi: While holding Mistletoe, the user can right-click a non-player creature to apply the Mistletoe effect for %s seconds.

At the maximum level, further uses still extend the duration.
When Mistletoe expires naturally, each level deals sourceless magic damage equal to %s%% of the target’s maximum health.

In addition, when the effect ends, a single “Parasitic Separation” roll is made. On success, the former effect holder drops one of each identifiable item in its loot table. Each level of Mistletoe provides a %1$s%% success chance, with this drop guaranteed at level %2$s.
Removing the effect early or the target dying before Mistletoe expires triggers neither backlash nor additional loot.
Each successful use consumes 1 Mistletoe; if the target cannot receive the effect, none is consumed.

Growth acceleration applies to crops, saplings, pumpkin and melon stems, nether wart, cocoa, sweet berry bushes, sugar cane, cacti, bamboo, and the growing tips of kelp, weeping vines, twisting vines, and similar plants.

Growth acceleration provides each plant with at most 1 additional natural growth opportunity every %s seconds, while still requiring its own growth conditions to be met. Overlapping growth areas do not stack.

In Sunflower Plains, Flower Forest, Cherry Grove, or Meadow biomes, the wearer gains %1$s%% movement speed and takes %2$s%% less damage.
When the wearer deals damage, there is a %s%% chance to deal additional damage equal to the actual damage of that hit. Each successful additional hit has the same chance to trigger another.
In Sunflower Plains, Flower Forest, Cherry Grove, or Meadow biomes, the wearer deals %s%% more damage.
Pending additional damage ends for any of the following reasons:
1. The wearer removes The Long Travail;
3. The wearer no longer has the Witness of Flourishing;
4. The wearer or target dies, leaves the loaded area, or leaves the dimension where the original hit occurred.
